purpose: ONE supervised physical 15-page native request on a complex-layout/table/formula-rich document (paper_eng_64b5e1f4) at the official deployment budget class (39321 new tokens) with the official no-repeat suppression (35/1024, generated ids only), on the frozen model/weights/prompt/crop policy, executed from the CLEAN migrated history. Production defaults are NOT changed: budgets above 8192 and suppression remain opt-in behind pinned-digest policies; this digest authorizes this experiment only.
claim_limit: One document, one attempt. NOT MPDocBench accuracy, NOT leaderboard parity, NOT official-deployment parity (no windowing, no KV reuse). 15-page promotion requires ALL gates PASS including 15/15 pages emitted, natural valid completion, zero forced-marker mismatches and zero supervision failures. Second L1.1 attempt (case A substitute or other) requires a fresh gate review AFTER this attempt's evidence is sealed.
page_hash_order: frozen-index order, page_1..page_15; worker verifies actual bytes against BOTH this list and the frozen page-index gate

admission.rule: pages*prompt_upper_bound + budget + margin must not exceed context_cap_tokens

ngram_scope: generated tokens only (official SGLang SGLANG_UOCR_NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY=True semantics; frozen model loop scans gen only)
ngram_provenance: official client infer.py@48ff432 (docs/rca/NGRAM35_SOURCE_AUDIT.md); the guard-collision corner is LIVE at this budget class per docs/validation/P2C_GUARD_COLLISION_SAFETY.md §6

guard_collision_safety.contract: observer aborts before selection on the audited corner; any abort classifies the attempt FAIL and BLOCKS promotion; the post-run replay forced-marker detector remains a HARD gate with no bypass
guard_collision_safety.observer: opt-in pre-selection all--inf abort (src/unlimited_ocr_2_rocm/collision_observer.py), installed for this attempt

ledger.not_run_marking: NOT_RUN for the other 419 documents; NOT_RUN is never PASS

resource_admission.gpu_enforcement: worker ResourceWatchdog samples torch.cuda.memory_allocated and aborts the attempt (exit 86 + breach receipt) when the hard limit is crossed — enforced during execution, not merely checked afterward
resource_admission.timeout_rationale: L1 measured this budget class at 1214 s wall for a dense book (13151 tokens, 10.93 tok/s). The paper class is denser per page (288 layout dets vs 323 over same 15 pages, plus equations/tables); the reviewed integral model (linear step-time over S, ~1.9x point estimate) is retained unchanged at 14400 s. May only be changed via a reviewed policy update BEFORE the run, never mid-run.

environment_pin.wheel_source: wheels/ local builds (gfx1151); unchanged from L1

scoring.strict: official scorer, frozen selection; TableTEDS/T-TableTEDS/FormulaCDM evaluated where samples exist (paper has 7 tables + 7 equations, so unlike L1 these are expected to be non-null)
scoring.diagnostic: diagnostic scorer receipt as in L1; full denominator accounting preserved (1 executed + 419 NOT_RUN)
